title: Multi-Floor Commercial TI Case Study - 259 Issues Found
summary: New case study: AI review of a three-floor commercial tenant improvement found 259 issues across 6 disciplines. 35 critical issues including fire protection conflicts, seismic bracing prohibitions, and accessibility violations. Demonstrates AI's ability to catch drawing-to-specification conflicts.
